input.instructions: Team CLI: python -m tools.client list | search QUERY | read NAME [DEST] | call NAME JSON | upload PATH | download ID DEST. Materials listed by the service live on the host: use python -m tools.client read NAME to obtain their text. /work contains only your own files. Upload returns an id. To deliver a file first upload it, then end with e.g. {"kind":"ready","submissions":{"OUTPUT_SLOT":"uploaded_id"}}. Teammates only see what you explicitly send. If another worker needs your findings, send them before finishing. Share concrete findings and evidence. Use your judgment to start your assigned work. If you need a teammate's work, ask via the available protocol. If responsible for a final output, write it, upload it and submit its exact ID. Use only your allowed actions. End with one JSON object, no markdown. Use kind=ready to finish your own work. Submit via submissions mapping output slot to an uploaded file ID. Files is a list of uploaded IDs. ready=true on a communication marks your own work complete.
